xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3158 — named retained / message-later / steer-mid-flight sub-agent semantic in swarm (extends #2510/#673).

plan.title: feat(swarm): retained addressable sub-agents — message-later and steer-mid-flight semantics

narratives.Description: Name the retained sub-agent semantic in swarm guidance: full agents with persistent identity, results as messages, parent can steer mid-flight and re-message the same child later. Directive swarm is largely dispatch-and-collect; #2510/#2516 adjacent but do not fully name this. Couples to #3155 nuclear-family topology bounds (prefer co-land or explicit temporary deferral of bounds). Capability-gate for hosts that cannot retain. Align #3179/#3164: retention is for orchestration, not mid-run constitution self-edit. Also amends mid-scope gate split-dispatch mandate (#954) per host capability when retain is supported.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1) Author swarm documentation source files naming retained-child dispatch as a mode alongside dispatch-and-collect (when to keep a worker alive vs one-shot); cross-link #3155 and capability-gate language for hosts without retain.
2) Update content/skills/deft-directive-swarm skill source (and host adapters as needed) to note continue-by-agent-id/name where the host supports it; pointer only for missing hosts.
3) Where always-loaded AGENTS applies the mid-scope split-dispatch rule (#954), add capability-tiered language via content/templates/agents-entry.md and task agents:refresh (#1309) so retained hosts may single-dispatch with mid-scope gate without forcing a second full dispatch.
4) Align stance with #3164 (not self-edit); CHANGELOG; verify with task agents:refresh and task check.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm orchestrator on a host that can resume children by id, I want a named retained-child mode and capability-gated guidance, so that I can steer mid-flight without paying a second full dispatch on every mid-scope gate.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Issue AC: named semantic, #3155 co-land or deferral note, capability-gated language, skill pointer, CHANGELOG.

items.title: Named retained-child semantic in swarm docs

narrative.Acceptance: Given swarm documentation source files, when an orchestrator loads the retained-child section, then the docs return a named retained / message-later / steer-mid-flight mode beside dispatch-and-collect and record a #3155 cross-link or explicit temporary bounds deferral.

Given deft-directive-swarm skill source, when the host supports continue-by-agent-id, then the skill returns that path; when the host cannot retain, then the skill records split-dispatch or one-shot semantics instead.

Given agents-entry SoT and task agents:refresh, when the always-loaded mid-scope gate prose is written, then capability-tiered retain language is recorded without reversing #3164; CHANGELOG records the surface.
